title: Converge stale Metarepo worktree lifecycle without discarding foreign work
goal: Classify and safely converge the 19 linked non-main Metarepo worktrees that currently block broad repository work admission, while preserving dirty work, respecting foreign lifecycle owners and repairing binding identity drift only from external terminal truth.

approval.note: Classification and recovery preparation are allowed. No dirty checkout reset, foreign-owner takeover, branch deletion or physical cleanup is authorized without exact terminal evidence, recovery refs, dry-run and reviewed target binding.

acceptance.assertion: All 19 linked non-main Metarepo worktrees are bound to exact path, HEAD, branch, dirty state, owner, lease, process, task, PR/merge status and lifecycle decision.
The two currently dirty worktrees are reviewed and preserved through an explicit owner handoff, commit or recovery artifact; none is reset, overwritten or deleted.
Foreign lifecycle owners are neither replaced nor inferred terminal. Each foreign binding is reconciled only from authoritative task, PR, lease, process and branch truth.
Every binding_identity_drift row is repaired or retained with a precise blocker; archive and retention heads are never silently rewritten.
Only clean, externally terminal candidates with recovery refs, mature archive evidence, no coordination and a hash-bound cleanup dry-run may be removed.
A final fresh repository admission assessment reports allow, or lists only deliberately retained blockers with assigned follow-up ownership; no broad claim is asserted prematurely.

conditions: a target has a live foreign lease, process, task or PR mutation
dirty content cannot be attributed or preserved losslessly
branch or merge status is ambiguous
recovery refs or exact cleanup-plan binding are unavailable
the requested operation would require force, reset or history rewrite

does_not_establish: that broad Metarepo admission is currently safe
